body.subject: Codex judge verdict: item48-balances-chain-order-r6 = C
body.text: artifact=item48-balances-chain-order-r6 kind=code purpose=tri7 item 48 round 6 — all three round-5 C blockers fixed: (1) source_sha256.txt regenerated for the final bytes (checker hash now matches the packaged file); (2) the convergence claim corrected — the live canary transcript shows the retry scheduled and started, not completed; the converged-retry shape is a labelled synthetic selftest and the re-deploy's exit 0 will demonstrate it live; (3) the retry line is height-associated to the judged build (a different build's retry line does not count), with two new selftests. 21-case selftest green. Decisions: commit this checker fix to master and re-deploy per brief section 7 worktree=/tmp/codex-judge-DZmS8v codex_grade=C judge=codex
reasons: The checker parses successfully and its 21-case selftest passes, including both new mismatched-retry cases.
Retry lines are now associated with the judged build by matching both coverage and chased heights.

However, 2_balances_chain_ordered.py lines 24-25 still claim the live DNS3 retry converged, and lines 147-150 repeat that claim. The same false statement remains in 1_item48_check_fix.diff. The live transcript in 4_ev_deploy_dns3.txt shows only the retry scheduling/start context before rollback, not a completed retry. This directly contradicts the stated round-6 purpose and remains an unverified claim.
blocking_issues: Correct the remaining live-convergence claims in 2_balances_chain_ordered.py and 1_item48_check_fix.diff to state that completion is represented only by the labelled synthetic selftest; then regenerate the source hash manifest for the corrected bytes.
